configuration_rationale: Single Q1-grouped template selected for the first matched-path feasibility check because prior measured service time was longer than the other three probes, without changing SQL/data or artificially slowing it. New verified SF1 clone retains measured source file count via recorded repartition intervention. Before/during/after interference queries pin exactly the original snapshot/file inventory; compacted-snapshot benefit is separate. One foreground probe only, maintenance-first trigger from actual active rewrite tasks. A missed overlap is preserved/refused, never repaired with fake latency. Ten-Hz minimal active-stage polling and a sixty-second observation ceiling are operational settings for short real SF1 tasks; ceiling never cancels maintenance, which finishes naturally. CPU/process counters and instrumentation overhead remain part of actual host conditions. Exact row multiset and file conservation required. This is one matched measurement-integrity pilot, not independent repetitions, causal/statistical cost inference, traced replay, forecasting, small-file eligibility or training approval. No new physical statement after the authorized 06:15 IST cutoff; running operations are not force-cancelled.

telemetry.rationale: One-second real host counter cadence, five-minute warmup plus five-second margin; retain existing 95% coverage and two-second gap/freshness gates. Exact bounds/available frontier and actual submission freshness are independently checked. No normalized demand assumed.
